content.title: 2026 Oscar Winners: Full List of Winners and Nominees
content.text: The biggest night in Hollywood has arrived, and the 2026 Oscar winners have officially been revealed. The annual ceremony from the Academy Awards celebrates the year’s best achievements in film, honoring outstanding performances, technical excellence, and unforgettable storytelling. This year’s ceremony featured a wide range of films competing for the industry’s most prestigious awards, including Sinners, Frankenstein, One Battle After Another, and Hamnet. Below is the full list of 2026 Oscar winners and nominees. Amy Madigan. Credit : Patrick T.
